messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — GPU_POOL_MEM_PRESSURE — pool=gpu-prod-6 region=us-west-2 severity=high pager=P12345

incident-bot: symptoms: repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in inference-service logs; KV cache evictions spiking; per-pool free_mem dropping below 200MB.

Logs:
```
[2026-03-15T18:07:12Z] inference-service gpu-prod-6: alloc returned error cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
[2026-03-15T18:07:12Z] model rw-7b: kv_cache_evicted 4231 entries
```

pagerduty: Incident P12345 triggered, urgent -> @maya is primary oncall

maya: acked in PD. I'm on it. Starting triage.

alex: I'm nearby, can take traffic steering if needed.

maya: first check - are customers seeing 5xx? Telemetry shows a 4.8% increase in 5xx for route `/v1/generate` since 18:05 UTC. Spike concentrated in us-west-2.

samir: probable cause: kvcache fragmentation + a large request causing allocation spike. Quick mitigation: 1) disable pooling to pool gpu-prod-6 in routing policy, 2) fallback to smaller model variant `rw-3b-q4f` for new requests, 3) restart long-lived inference pods on that pool to free GPU memory.

maya: Executing route change: `rbx route update --pool-exclude gpu-prod-6 --policy immediate` -> UI shows traffic shifting.

deploy-bot: route change accepted, new policy applied.

maya: applying fallback rules: added `model_fallback: rw-3b-q4f` for route `/v1/generate` for region us-west-2.

pagerduty: maya acknowledged P12345 at 2026-03-15T18:08:10Z

taylor: I'll drain node `gpunode-12` from pool gpu-prod-6 and restart pods. Command: `kubectl cordon gpunode-12 && kubectl delete pod -l pool=gpu-prod-6 -n inference` — expect 20-40s for restarts.

maya: running logs while restart proceeds:
```
[2026-03-15T18:09:02Z] pod inference-6a7: cuda: out of memory on alloc 512MB
[2026-03-15T18:09:18Z] pod inference-6a7: terminated (OOM)
[2026-03-15T18:09:45Z] pod inference-8b2: started, model rw-3b-q4f
```

samir: good—tail latency on /v1/generate dropping back toward baseline, 95th p50 improving. Need to monitor KV cache eviction rate.

maya: eviction rate down from 600/s -> 80/s after restart + fallback. 5xx rate down to 1.2% within 3m.

alex: any customer-facing impact to log? Should we open a support ticket or post incident status?

maya: minor customer impact (partial errors for <30min). I'll draft a short status note for support: `brief: There was a transient GPU memory pressure in us-west-2 affecting ~5% of realtime requests; we mitigated by routing and restarts; fallback model applied; no data loss.`

pagerduty: Auto-escalation suppressed — incident acknowledged; escalation timers paused.

ops-bot: Added tag `mitigated` to P12345. Please provide postmortem notes in the runbook thread.

taylor: running `nvidia-smi` on gpunode-12 before cordon showed GPU mem 98% util and pinned processes from `inference-6a7`.

maya: next steps: - leave fallback in place for 30m, - watch for re-increase in evictions, - follow up with model team to check recent rollout (any model changes?)

samir: model team confirms no model rollout in last 24h. Suggest we check recent traffic with long prompt sizes; large prompts triggered the OOM.

maya: found a spike of long-prompts (avg tokens per request rose from 120 -> 240) starting 18:04 UTC.

alex: put a short-term prompt-length limiter at the gateway? e.g., reject > 600 tokens for realtime routes. Could throttle large requests.

maya: applied soft limiter: `gateway-config set max_tokens 600 --route /v1/generate --mode warn` — will convert to hard limit if we see repeats.

pagerduty: P12345 status -> acknowledged, mitigated. Waiting for owner to close.

maya: handing off to next oncall @samir for watch window and postmortem. Summary: GPU mem pressure on gpu-prod-6 due to unexpected long prompt spike + kvcache fragmentation; mitigated by routing exclusion, pod restarts, fallback model; impact: transient 5xx on ~5% of requests for ~18m. Runbook link: https://runbook.internal/redwood/gpu-memory-pressure

samir: ack — I'll own watch window 30m and start postmortem draft.

maya: closing slack thread for now. If re-escalation -> ping PD.

incident-bot: P12345 closed by owner samir at 2026-03-15T18:45:12Z
